decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the required inclusion of the tribute page; no additional update or removal is needed.
Adding and positioning the tribute page does not change the digital flipbook deliverable requirement.
The source does not change any image-quality or enhancement requirement.
The tribute-page placement decision does not alter the launch target or deadline.
The source specifies content inclusion and placement but does not change the magazine's visual style or branding rules.
The source does not establish that the tribute page is an article or modify any author-attribution rule.
The tribute-page placement decision does not change treatment of long article text or the use of text-break elements.
